name: Member's Mark Chicken Alfredo with Penne Pasta (Deli Bake Warning)
whyItWorks: Tender penne pasta and chicken smothered in a heavy cream, butter, and parmesan sauce. Over 28g of dairy fat per serving triggers intense gastrocolic reflexes and diarrhea in sensitive bowels.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Heavy Cream & Lipid Hazard: Avoid during flare-ups. In remission, eat a small portion paired with extra plain chicken.
